music03.title: Iron Veil (Industrial Theme)
music03.prompt: Dark cinematic electronic battle music for a real-time strategy game, fully instrumental, steady driving pulse at about 105 BPM. Industrial djent guitar chugs and syncopated polyrhythmic riffs, mysterious low synth drones and eerie atmospheric pads, punchy layered war drums with metallic hits, deep sub bass ostinato and sparse tense string figures; dense powerful low end with restrained dark highs.
